name: truenorthit
description: Claude Code plugins for building against TrueNorth IT services — the Dataverse Contact API, GOV.UK Design System services, and local model offload.

plugins.name: dataverse-portal
plugins.description: Scaffold a React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Auth0 SPA against the Dataverse Contact API, following the patterns from dataverse-example-case-portal.

plugins.name: create-gds-service
plugins.description: Scaffold or remove a GOV.UK Design System (GDS) service in a service-builder-flow style repo — folder, pages, GDS-compliant copy, Dataverse row CLI (with safety-gated delete), and OpenAPI verification.

plugins.name: dataverse-terraform
plugins.description: Define, and explain, a Dataverse Contact API portal backend as Terraform — export an existing scope into HCL and adopt it into state, scaffold and provision a new one, or read a config back in plain English. Uses the public TrueNorthIT/dataversecontact provider.

plugins.name: bigmac
plugins.description: Offload grunt work (summaries, first-pass code exploration, bulk classification, drafts) to bigmac, the office Ollama server, instead of burning frontier tokens. Never touches Claude Code's own endpoint or login.
